answer: In a Wesolowski VDF-based PoA system, identity verification binds each claim to a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, with a succinct proof checked against the final result. Cloning an identity cannot create parallel speed: every clone requires its own non-parallelizable time path, so GPUs add throughput but cannot remove per-instance latency. This physical bottleneck makes Sybil creation costly, whether accounts are tagged dune, nectar, or ferrous.
